candidate_parent: highest causal observed routing mass among current active experts
candidate_training: 64 distinct matured intervals after creation; shadow optimizer only
qualification: 32 later distinct intervals; live and candidate-deployed full-model logits recorded before label reveal
acceptance: paired supervised-loss relative improvement >=1% and normal-host mean anomaly probability <= live+0.01
activation_optimizer_rule: candidate Adam moments reset on activation; existing live expert moments preserved by stable expert_id|tensor_name keys
dormant_reactivation_rule: not exercised in this first three-law pilot because retirement is disabled; dormant infrastructure remains available
calibration_note: numeric loss threshold is deterministically derived once from the first 256 matured development intervals using the 99th percentile of 32-interval window means; it is not changed after observing D-C performance
